bias.en: Uptrend · broke out above $250, RSI overbought
bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 突破 $250，RSI 超买

read.en: Zscaler rose 7.3% on Oct 23 to $255.15, trading between $234.19 and $255.55 on 1.4 times average volume. It is above all its rising averages: 5-day ($230.3), 10-day ($225.4), 30-day ($211.2), 100-day ($170.9) and 200-day ($166.0). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 22 and above zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 22 ($204.09), and RSI is 72.
read.zh: Zscaler 10月23日上涨 7.3%，收于 $255.15，盘中区间 $234.19–255.55，成交量为平均水平的 1.4 倍。股价位于所有上行均线上方：5 日（$230.3）、10 日（$225.4）、30 日（$211.2）、100 日（$170.9）和 200 日均线（$166.0）。MACD 自 10月22日起位于信号线及零轴上方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月22日起看多（$204.09），RSI 为 72。

read.en: The rally cleared the $241.1 Oct 22 high and $250, both now support, and closed near the day's high with RSI above 70. Resistance is $255.6 (Oct 23 high), then $260 and $270 (round numbers). Support is $250, then $241.1 and $231.6–237.2 (Oct 22 low, Oct 12 high). A close above $255.6 would target $260–270; a close below $241 would reopen $231.6–237.2.
read.zh: 此轮上涨突破 $241.1（10月22日高点）和 $250，二者转为支撑，收盘接近全日高点，RSI 高于 70。阻力为 $255.6（10月23日高点），其次 $260 和 $270（整数关口）。支撑为 $250，其次 $241.1 和 $231.6–237.2（10月22日低点、10月12日高点）。若收盘站上 $255.6，下一目标看 $260–270；若收盘跌破 $241，将重新打开 $231.6–237.2。

s.en: Oct 12 high $237.2; Oct 23 low $234.2; Oct 22 low $231.6
